overview_description.description:
THIS IS NOT A STORM is the Lean Innovation Consultancy 

We design and run bespoke innovation programs for bold organizations. Using both Internal and Open innovation, our programs have a significant impact on profitability, reputation and internal culture growth – all in a predictable and measurable way.

Through the INNOVATION ENGINEERING PROCESS, we cover all the stages of the Innovation lifecycle - from STRATEGY to SCALE.

Our programs can take different shapes:
One day workshops - designed for speed to AHA!
Innovation Challenges -  from the opportunity to launch in 3 weeks
End to end Innovation - designed to follow through innovation from opportunity to concrete results

All of our engagements focus on how we can drive meaningful growth in your organization.

Our portfolio includes: Avon Europe, Beiersdorf Global, Edenred, Enel, Immochan, NN Life Insurance, Superbet, Ve Interactive, UNIQA
